Help surface advertises use, toolchain, validate-json, inspect-project-yml, inspect-target-features, compare-project-yml-pkl, import-project-yml, generate-project-yml, generate-xcodeproj, --common-process-spec, and shared Xcode workspace product-cache flags

README names Swift tools 6.4, use mode, toolchain mode, validate-json, Apple project migration commands, and shared Xcode workspace product-cache flags; remaining craze wording is limited to read-only legacy annotation compatibility
The Pkl project-generation bead is a blocker for internal v0.0.1
Mono startup reported 511 diff-files; release prep must rely on scoped paths

Creative Selection v0.2 proves first-slice Pkl-backed .xcodeproj world-state generation, but final internal release still waits for fleet build parity and explicit quarantine of remaining XcodeGen-backed owned surfaces
inspect-project-yml parsed Concourse project.yml and 155/155 discovered project.yml files under private/universal/substrate/collectives; this proves read compatibility, not build success

Provenance artifact captures receipts, validation commands, savepoint events, and forward Pkl migration boundary
Concourse project.pkl amends AppleProjectSpec.pkl and compare-project-yml-pkl uses PklSwift to report zero mismatches against legacy project.yml

import-project-yml generated Creative Selection v0.2 project.pkl and compare-project-yml-pkl reported zero mismatches, but .xcodeproj world-state is not generated
generate-xcodeproj generated first-slice .xcodeproj world-state from Creative Selection v0.2 project.pkl and emitted a receipt with buildableWorldStateGenerated=true

CUJ-15 proves product-cache option parsing, paired option validation, shared cache lookup before local DerivedData, and Xcode build invocation through the shared workspace/DerivedData pair; automatic workspace scheme discovery remains deferred

why-vaporize.md explains why Vaporize exists, what problems it solves, how it compares to Swift, xcodebuild, and xcrun, current benchmark baselines, build-space savings theory, ergonomics, and remaining benchmark gaps

performance-marketing-claims.md defines safe performance claim language, examples, before/after copy, prohibited claims, and the benchmark receipts needed before stronger speed or disk-space claims are allowed
product-definition.md defines Vaporize, primary users, product-level journeys, why users choose it, when not to choose it, and build implications before further build work is accepted

Kura runtime sample series is seeded and a backfilled CUJ-09 sample verifies SwiftPM coverage JSON/profile data plus build-size metrics, but Vaporize does not yet emit samples automatically, retain Apple result artifacts, or compare per-feature-flag size cohorts as durable release evidence

Existing wrkstrm-core app/build config sources are identified: tool-registry discover-apps and xcode-project tool records for app project ownership, identifier app describe for canonical app variant names and paths, and app-artifacts for bundle audits, install paths, Xcode build/export receipts, and flat .app artifacts. Vaporize integration remains a follow-up.

inspect-target-features now inspects the target-level release-feature topology for Hello World Google: project configs, configFiles wiring, Config/release-features.json, generated conditional-compilation xcconfigs, generated ReleaseFeatures.swift, and digikoma-release-features provenance. Registry-backed fleet inspection remains a follow-up.

extensions.x-release-prep-note: This packet is release-prep evidence, not final founder approval.
extensions.x-tool-classification: internal-essential-tool: internal-only, release-gating assistant tool whose absence blocks build/install/launch/release-proof workflows.
extensions.x-common-process-use-surface: use mode consumes CommonProcess CommandSpec JSON via --common-process-spec and emits a vaporize-use-common-process receipt when requested.
extensions.x-toolchain-surface: toolchain mode owns Xcode-selected Swift invocation; assistants should not call xcrun directly.
extensions.x-json-validation-surface: validate-json mode owns JSON packet validation; assistants should not call jq directly.
extensions.x-apple-project-yml-inspection: inspect-project-yml parses legacy XcodeGen project.yml files into Swift AppleProjectSpec data and emits a vaporize-apple-project-yml-inspection receipt. It is read-only migration intake, not forward source-of-truth generation. Fleet audit parsed 155/155 discovered project.yml files under private/universal/substrate/collectives.
extensions.x-old-tool-vaporize-build-comparison: Concourse old XcodeGen script build and Vaporize app build both pass after Vaporize derives legacy WRAPPER_NAME from project.yml. The first Vaporize run exposed and then closed an artifact-location default mismatch.
extensions.x-provenance-artifact: vaporize-v0.0.1-provenance-artifact.json collects release-prep receipts, validation commands, savepoints, proven claims, unproven claims, and the forward Pkl migration path.
extensions.x-pkl-parity-specimen: Concourse now has project.pkl amending AppleProjectSpec.pkl. compare-project-yml-pkl evaluates Pkl through PklSwift, decodes YAML and Pkl into AppleProjectSpec, and emits a zero-mismatch comparison receipt.
extensions.x-pkl-transitional-yaml-generation: generate-project-yml evaluates Concourse project.pkl through PklSwift and emits transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML plus a generation receipt. The generated YAML compares back to Pkl with zero mismatches, but .xcodeproj world-state is not generated.
extensions.x-yml-to-pkl-import: import-project-yml renders legacy XcodeGen YAML into an AppleProjectSpec Pkl parity specimen. Creative Selection v0.2 now has a generated project.pkl and a zero-mismatch comparison receipt.
extensions.x-pkl-xcodeproj-generation: generate-xcodeproj evaluates Creative Selection v0.2 project.pkl through PklSwift and emits first-slice .xcodeproj world-state plus a vaporize-pkl-xcodeproj-generation receipt. This proves one app specimen, not fleet build parity.
extensions.x-schema-universal-extraction: vaporize-schemas v0.0.1 extracts JSON schemas, canonical fixtures, and a fixture-backed Swift model package for Vaporize CUJ coverage, provenance, launch-review specialization, and Apple project YAML/Pkl receipts under schema-universal.
extensions.x-xcode-workspace-product-cache: Shared Xcode workspace product-cache reuse lets app installs search a warm workspace DerivedData product before local outputs and build through the shared workspace/DerivedData pair on cache miss. CUJ-15 covers the first slice; automatic workspace scheme/product discovery remains deferred.
extensions.x-why-vaporize: why-vaporize.md is the release-facing explanation for why Vaporize is better, what problems it solves, how it compares to Swift/xcodebuild/xcrun, what current benchmarks show, how shared cache reuse can save build space, and which performance claims remain unmeasured.
extensions.x-product-definition-contract: product-definition.md defines Vaporize, primary users, product-level user journeys, why users choose it, when not to choose it, and build implications; future feature work must trace to this contract before implementation and release claims are accepted.
extensions.x-performance-marketing-claims: performance-marketing-claims.md provides approved copy examples and guardrails: do not say Vaporize is faster than Swift, do not claim 2x Xcode builds, and do not claim N GB disk savings until dedicated benchmark receipts exist; every claim must trace to product-definition.md.
extensions.x-runtime-sample-series: Kura series seeded at private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm/private/universal/kura-spaces/series/vaporize-runtime-samples. Backfilled CUJ-09 sample records a Vaporize toolchain SwiftPM coverage run, verified codecov JSON/profile data, build-output size, Debug product size, codecov artifact size, and Vaporize binary size. Automatic sample emission and durable artifact retention remain follow-ups.
extensions.x-apple-native-artifacts: Runtime evidence should leverage SwiftPM code coverage JSON, raw .profraw/default.profdata, xUnit output when available, Xcode .xcresult bundles, result metadata, build logs, diagnostics, DerivedData/product paths, product/binary/bundle sizes, coverage artifact size, result bundle size, cache deltas, and per-feature-flag size cohorts before inventing parallel measurement formats.
extensions.x-wrkstrm-core-build-config-composition: App-facing Vaporize samples should compose with existing wrkstrm-core build sources instead of inventing a second config registry: tool-registry@wrkstrm-core.cli discover-apps and xcode-project.tool.json records for app/project ownership, identifier@wrkstrm-core.cli app describe for canonical app variant names and paths, app-artifacts@wrkstrm-core.cli for bundle audits/install paths/Xcode build-export receipts, and release-features.json or generated xcconfig files when feature cohorts exist.
extensions.x-wrkstrm-app-minimums: inspect-target-features now knows whether a project.yml target satisfies the target-level release-feature topology: project configs, declared tiers, Config/release-features.json, generated Config/xcconfigs/*.xcconfig, project configFiles or Pkl wiring, generated Sources/ReleaseFeatures.swift, and digikoma-release-features provenance. Hello World Google is the reference specimen; registry-backed fleet inspection remains a follow-up.
extensions.x-performance-baseline: Local baseline at 2026-06-14T00:44:00Z: validate-json launch packet 0.03s real; vaporize toolchain swift --version 0.25s real; bare swift --version 0.17s real; focused CUJ-15 bare swift and Vaporize toolchain both 6.80s real; earlier full Vaporize suite 15.57s real with 82 tests. Latest full Vaporize suite verification passed 87 tests in 9.61s wall-clock via Codex command runner; focused CUJ-09 coverage run 29.38s real with SwiftPM codecov JSON/profile data and build-size metrics verified.
extensions.x-cuj-test-coverage: Required test count is derived from PRD requirements through active draft CUJs. Current floor: 69 Swift test obligations plus 6 release evidence checks across 16 active CUJs. Current executable suite: 87 Swift tests across 16 implemented CUJ-specific SwiftPM bundles, including CUJ-16 target feature inspection.
extensions.x-major-feature-test-suite: Vaporize package tests now cover major implemented release features through 16 CUJ-specific SwiftPM bundles: command parsing, pass/use/toolchain receipts, JSON validation, inventory scanner/renderer, graph forwarding, Apple project YAML/Pkl migration paths, first-slice Pkl .xcodeproj generation, shared Xcode workspace product-cache reuse, target feature inspection, SwiftPM CLI installer arguments, and app installer Xcode invocation paths.
extensions.x-pkl-project-generation-gate: Internal v0.0.1 release is blocked until our owned Apple project-generation path has fleet build parity from Pkl-backed .xcodeproj world-state generation, with any leftover XcodeGen surfaces quarantined as compatibility.
extensions.x-xcodegen-to-pkl-investigation: Investigation found 155 project.yml files, 185 checked-in .xcodeproj/project.pbxproj files, direct XcodeGen runner surfaces, and no existing Pkl Apple-project generation model. The first approved mitigation slice now reads legacy YAML through Swift and receipts Concourse inspection.
